name: npc-luna
source: Luna, a female VR companion (named by the owner, 21 Nov 2026), from the owner's own Meshy generation of 18 Nov 2026 (a static neon dancer posed mid-dance with one leg raised; his own account). Remade standing: Meshy image-to-3d (meshy-6-lite, a-pose, textured) from a front render of his model, then Meshy auto-rig at 1.70 m; prepared by prepare_meshy.py. Her clips are the female companion figure's (vr-companion-f.glb), retargeted (build with --crowd and --rest vr-companion-f.glb).
